name: prism-fraud
description: Prism Fraud decides approve, review or decline for every card authorisation in microseconds. It keeps exact sliding windows per card, device and IP (counts, sums, distinct cards), a running spend profile per card, and the last known location for impossible-travel checks. Analysts write rules in a small language (`rule "card-testing" decline when ip.cards_1h >= 4 and amount < 100`) that is parsed by a Pratt parser, linted against known fields and hot-reloaded without a deploy. A 14-feature logistic model, trained on synthetic traffic with ground truth and updated online from chargebacks and analyst verdicts, adds a calibrated score with per-feature explanations. A synthetic traffic generator with four fraud patterns (card testing, account takeover, cloned cards, bust-out) measures precision, recall and money saved.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
